questions.prompt: You approach a red, eight-sided sign marked STOP. What does it mean?

options.text: Only slowing is required.
Stopping is required only if another car is visible.
A full stop is required.
The road becomes one-way.

questions.explanation: Stop completely before the marked stop line. With no line, stop before the crosswalk, marked or unmarked; if none, use the sidewalk edge, then the intersection edge if there is no sidewalk. Check and yield before entering.
